messages.subject: For David Gitlin | Intelligent climate, energy efficiency and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Carrier Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. David Gitlin, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Carrier's intelligent-climate and energy-efficiency strategy increasingly sits at the intersection of public policy, infrastructure investment, sustainability and customer transformation. Those priorities align closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of sustainability, government relations and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Carrier's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Carrier Global.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
